cases.sentence: Зачем тебе грешить против ___, убив Давида без всякой причины?
cases.explain: «невиновного человека» — after the preposition «против», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: for he put his life in his hand, and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it, and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”

cases.sentence: Саул послал людей в ___, но и те стали пророчествовать.
cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.

cases.sentence: Наконец, он сам отправился в Раму и пришел к ___ в Сеху.
cases.explain: «огромному колодцу» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”
